- Formation complémentaire complétée FMH diagn. Radiologie ou réussite du 2ème examen de spécialiste ou équivalent en radiologie diagnostique

- Travailler de manière indépendante dans un large spectre de radiologie avec une ouverture à l'innovation

- Formation et enseignement spécifiques dans tout le spectre du diagnostic et de la thérapie sénologique

- Un campo di attività vario e responsabile
- Un team ginecologico motivato ed esperto con processi decisionali brevi

Description

As a successful clinic with a private character, Bethesda Hospital combines top-class medicine with first-class service and a unique feel-good atmosphere. With its five focus topics: women's medicine, pregnancy & birth, musculoskeletal system, rehabilitation and palliative care, our every year, 6,000 inpatients benefit from state-of-the-art treatment centers under one roof – and this in the middle of one of the most beautiful hospital parks in northwestern Switzerland.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a dedicated person who enjoys a varied activity in a modern gynaecological clinic in the hospital. As a member of our team, you help to provide quick, competent and empathic care to women with acute and short-term gynaecological problems. At the same time, you have the opportunity to actively shape the development and further development of a new outpatient care offer.

Tasks

- Support for our patients from reception to the conclusion of the consultation - triage, organisation and coordination of appointments - telephone and via digital appointment booking systems - assistance in gynaecological examinations and diagnostic examinations (assistance in inserting spirals, small biopsies, punctures of the mamma, wound flushing) - conduct of blood sampling and urine analyses - preparation of instruments and examination rooms - administrative activities and electronic documentation

Requirements

- Completed training as medical practice assistant EFZ or qualified nursing specialist HF/FH - Professional experience in a gynaecological practice, gynaecological clinic or outpatient emergency care of advantage - knowledge in SAP, as well as safe handling of the common MS Office applications - joy in a dynamic working environment with varied tasks - self-employed, structured and responsible working methods - high patient orientation as well as team and communication skills - good German skills; further language skills are from Vortei

We offer

- The possibility to actively shape the expansion and further development of a new outpatient supply. - A modern working environment with the aim of continuously expanding digital processes - A varied and responsible field of activity - A motivated, experienced gynaecological team with short decision-making paths - Attractive working hours in the context of the operation of the gynaecological ambulatory - Opportunities for professional and personal further development

Contact

Are you interested in a team player or a team player and in this exciting challenge? For further questions and more information please contact Mrs. Isabell Räuber, clinic manager on +41 61 315 24 48 or via e-mail at isabell.raeuber@bethesda-spital.ch

We look forward to receiving your online application. Our recruitment process has been defined according to ecological and economic aspects and does not provide for applications by mail or e-mail. Post and e-mail applications are not taken into account. For this job, dossiers of job placements are not taken into account.

Siamo una clinica di formazione continua per la reumatologia (cat B due anni), la medicina del dolore (SSIPM, 1 anno), e la medicina interna (cat D, 6 mesi). C'è una stretta cooperazione interdisciplinare con l'università ortopedia interna, la chirurgia spinale e le cliniche interne per la riabilitazione, la medicina interna e la neurologia. La Clinica di Rheumatologia e Medicina del Dolore partecipa attivamente all'insegnamento medico-paziente (AP) presso la Facoltà di Medicina dell'Università di Basilea.

• Ammissione e cura degli inpatici della clinica
• Assistenza e infiltrazione in interventi muscoloscheletrici controllati da C-arc
• Trattamento degli ambulatori nel dolore del reumatismo ambulatorio (a seconda del livello di formazione e di esperienza nell'area ambulatoria)
• Giorno, notte, fine settimana e servizi di emergenza
• Partecipazione all'ulteriore programma di istruzione e formazione della clinica

• Studi completi

• Entusiasmo e motivazione per la professione e la gioia di imparare

• Mentoraggio e pianificazione del curriculum (cooperazione/rete della nostra clinica con le Cliniche Universitari Reumatologiche di Basilea e Berna)
• Opportunità di formazione sfaccettate
• Cooperazione interdisciplinare con diverse discipline

Bethesda Spital AG | online since : 01.09.2025

Bethesda Spital combines cutting-edge medicine with first-class service and a unique ambience. With the five focus areas musculoskeletal system, women’s rehabilitation, pregnancy & childbirth and palliative care, our 6,000 inpatients a year benefit from state-of-the-art treatment centers under one roof – in the middle of one of the most beautiful hospital parks in northwestern Switzerland.

Clinic Rheumatology & Pain Medicine is the largest rheumatology clinic in northwestern Switzerland. From now on or by agreement we are looking for an assistant doctor. We are a continuing education clinic for rheumatology (cat B two years), pain medicine (SSIPM, 1 year), and internal medicine (cat D, 6 months). There is a close interdisciplinary cooperation with the university orthopaedics in-house, spinal surgery and the internal clinics for rehabilitation, internal medicine and neurology. The Clinic of Rheumatology and Pain Medicine actively participates in doctor-patient (AP) teaching at the Faculty of Medicine of the University of Basel.

Their tasks

• Admission and care of inpatients of the clinic
• Assistance and infiltration in sono- and C-arc-controlled musculoskeletal interventions
• Treatment of outpatients in the ambulatory Rheumatism Pain (depending on the level of training and experience in the inpatient area)
• Day, night, weekend and emergency services
• Participation in the further education and training program of the clinic

They bring with them

• Completed studies
• At least 2 years of experience at a Swiss clinic (internal medicine and/or rheumatology)
• Verified and recognized diploma by MEBEKO
• Knowledge of German at least level C1 (Goethe Institute)
• Enthusiasm and motivation for the profession and the joy of learning
• Teamwork, flexibility and agility

We offer

• Learning to diagnose and manage a wide range of inflammatory and degenerative rheumatoid pain problems, including imaging anatomy (X-rays, MRI, CT, sonography) and image-guided interventions on joints, soft tissues and spine
• Mentoring and curriculum planning (cooperation/network of our clinic with the Rheumatological University Clinics Basel and Bern)
• Multifaceted training opportunities
• Interdisciplinary cooperation with different disciplines

Are you interested in this exciting challenge? We look forward to your online application. Our recruitment process has been defined according to environmental and economic aspects and does not provide for applications by post or email. Postal and e-mail applications will not be considered.
